def count_consecutive(s, start, length):
    count = 1
    while start + count < length and s[start] == s[start + count]:
        count += 1
    return count

def main():
    s = input().strip()
    l = len(s)
    c = 0
    i = 0
    while i < l - 1:
        if s[i] == s[i + 1]:
            z = count_consecutive(s, i, l)
            if z % 2 == 0:
                c += 1
            i += z
        else:
            i += 1
    print(c)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
